text: Build step 1 of the build order in docs/design/defaults-loop.md section 12: the introspection record, the class registry, the records-reading code (section 3.3), and a person-visible review of the output, using a language model for the prose and no Jev. Introspection is triggered by the event itself (section 3.1): every rejected or failed job, every correction and every intervention. Show the record in 'athena status <job>' so the user sees it without opening files. Reuse what 'athena backtest' already has (the introspection schema, the records reader, citation validation, the evidence-after-decision rule) instead of a second copy. Verify with fixture records in a temporary directory; agents' copies leave out records/, so the run over real records comes after landing.
